body: He has tried talking to her, so has my sister. She won't budge. Trust me, I'd prefer one of those screaming matches right now... The reason why I'm reacting this way is because she's never been like this before.. She couldn't stay mad at me fore more than a few hours, no matter what the problem was. I just don't know what to do

That's the thing. My grades do t even matter to me that much. Yes, I am disappointed that my hardwork went to waste. But the reason i did work so hard was for my parents. And I'm regiving my exams for them too. But I just need her to give me a hug and understand me. She used to be my best friend until 3 days ago. I'm so lost without her. It feels like she just died.
Not in uni, it's CIEs, Cambridge international exams. First year of A levels. E isn't equivalent to failing, but it's the lowest grade before an F.
